Name: Baker Hughes Co
Description: Baker Hughes Company (BKR) is a leading American industrial service firm and a prominent player in the global oil field services sector. With its headquarters in Houston, Texas, the company specializes in delivering innovative technologies and state-of-the-art services for the oil and gas industry, including drilling, formation evaluation, completion, production, and reservoir consulting. Baker Hughes is committed to advancing the energy transition by leveraging its expertise in both traditional and sustainable energy solutions, positioning itself as a key partner in the evolving energy landscape.
